key.name: icon-size
key.description: Icon size preset: tiny (32px), small (36px), standard (48px), or large (64px).

key.name: start-corner
key.description: Corner from which desktop icons are arranged: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right.

key.name: arrange-order
key.description: Sorting criteria for desktop entries: NAME, DESCENDINGNAME, MODIFIEDTIME, KIND, or SIZE.

key.name: sort-special-folders
key.summary: Sort special folders alongside regular files
key.description: When false, Home, Trash, and mounted drives stay pinned at the start of the grid.

key.name: show-home
key.summary: Show Personal Home folder on desktop
key.description: Display the user's home directory shortcut on the desktop grid.

key.name: show-trash
key.description: Display the freedesktop Trash shortcut on the desktop grid.

key.name: show-volumes
key.summary: Show mounted external drives on desktop
key.description: Display mounted removable and external volumes on the desktop grid.

key.name: show-network-volumes
key.summary: Show mounted network drives on desktop
key.description: Display mounted network shares (SFTP, SMB, NFS, WebDAV) on the desktop grid.

key.name: show-hidden-files
key.description: Include hidden files and folders starting with a dot when scanning ~/Desktop.

key.name: show-link-emblem
key.description: Display an emblem badge on symbolic link desktop tiles.

key.name: dark-text-in-labels
key.summary: Use dark text in desktop icon labels
key.description: Render dark icon labels with light shadow for bright desktop wallpapers.

key.name: single-click-open
key.summary: Open desktop items with a single click
key.description: When false, first click selects the icon and double-click opens it.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: Show desktop icons across all monitors
key.description: When true, render the desktop grid on all connected monitors instead of only the primary monitor.

key.name: show-selection-border
key.summary: Show accent border ring on selected and hovered tiles
key.description: Draw a Kelp/Reef accent border around selected and hovered desktop icon tiles.

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Selection and hover border thickness in pixels
key.description: Border thickness for selected and hovered desktop icon tiles (0-8 px).

key.name: border-radius
key.summary: Desktop tile corner radius in pixels
key.description: Corner rounding for desktop icon tiles (0-24 px).

key.name: border-color-rgba
key.summary: Selection and hover accent border color
key.description: CSS RGB/RGBA color string for desktop icon selection and hover borders.

key.name: icon-positions
key.summary: Custom desktop icon grid slot coordinates
key.description: JSON map of entry ID to custom {col, row} grid slot coordinates set via drag-and-drop.
